hero.title: Hallimane: Savor Authentic Rural Cuisine in Bangalore's Village Oasis
hero.subtitle: Experience the rich flavors of ethnic, value-for-money rural food within our charming, traditional village ambience.

about.title: Our Story: Two Decades of Authentic Rural Dining
about.paragraph1: Hallimane has been a landmark in the culinary map of Bangalore for well over 20 years. Located in a vintage part of Bangalore, the restaurant features a village ambience with its tiled roofs, natural brick walls, high ceilings and an abundance of plants; Hallimane has been proclaimed as one of the best ethnic and value for money restaurants in Bangalore by the media.
about.paragraph2: Hallimane is a destination for most Bangaloreans who prefer to savor the best of rural cuisine in a rural setting. We pride ourselves on serving fresh, hygienic and delicious rural food, complemented by exemplary service, ensuring an authentic and memorable dining experience.
